candidates.rule: The final score is the Players percentile, combining shop ALL and buyer ALL; `eval.score()` also reports the six component percentiles and values and the distance to the next bracket.
candidates.quote: Players 백분위, 가게 ALL·buyer ALL과 6개 요소의 백분위와 값, 다음 구간까지의 거리
candidates.harness: Expose the combined Players percentile and both ALL scores, along with the six components and next-bracket distance.

candidates.rule: Market SKU data covers units sold, sales speed, price distribution, and competitors' stock.
candidates.quote: 팔린 수, 속도, 가격 분포, 남의 재고
candidates.harness: Make these four kinds of SKU market data available to agents.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, the user decided that early market-selling results must be accompanied by a warning that the sample is small.
candidates.quote: 초반에는 표본이 적다고 함께 알린다 [결정] (2026-11-03)
candidates.harness: Display a small-sample warning with early market-selling results.

candidates.rule: Market-selling results summarize settled market lines by SKU and category for recent hours, along with the shop's recent sales; the collected data is updated every few minutes.
candidates.quote: 최근 몇 시간 동안 시장 정산 줄의 SKU·카테고리별 건수와 우리 가게의 최근 판매. 바깥 수집이 몇 분마다 `live.json`에 쌓은 값을 읽는다.
candidates.harness: Use recent settled sales and the shop's recent sales, and surface the collection time or freshness to the agent.

candidates.rule: Shelf-risk information includes remaining time, when grade will drop, and whether the unit or order meets `use_within_hours`.
candidates.quote: 남은 시간, 등급이 떨어질 시각, `use_within_hours` 충족 여부
candidates.harness: Provide all three shelf-risk facts when calculating unit or order risk.

candidates.rule: Fact-based star guidance uses only deal facts: agreement and receipt, truth of the claimed grade, expiry, and failure.
candidates.quote: 거래 사실(합의와 영수증, 주장한 등급의 참·거짓, 유통기한, 고장)만으로 정한 별점 기준값과 그 근거
candidates.harness: Calculate review guidance from those deal facts and provide its supporting reasons.

candidates.rule: Message extraction attempts to identify price, claimed grade, conditions, and item or SKU; on failure it returns no value and a displayed excerpt, leaving the caller to decide whether to use a small model.
candidates.quote: 가격, 주장한 등급, 조건, 품목·SKU를 뽑는다. 실패하면 값 없음과 표시한 원문 일부를 돌려주고, 호출한 쪽이 작은 모델 추출을 쓸지 정한다
candidates.harness: Pass extracted fields to the caller, preserve the failure excerpt, and do not invoke a small model without the caller's decision.

candidates.rule: A broken-item report is matched to our buyer's purchase from the same-named shop within six hours of the failure time; the match records the shop, warranty status, and surplus loss and updates the shop's profile and reputation.
candidates.quote: 이름이 같고 고장 시각 6시간 안쪽에 우리 buyer가 산 거래를 찾는다. 그 거래의 가게, 보증 여부, 잉여 손실을 기록하고 그 가게의 프로필과 평판에 반영한다.
candidates.harness: Match only purchases meeting the name and six-hour conditions, then record and apply the specified facts.

candidates.rule: If more than one purchase matches a broken-item report, retain every candidate and do not confirm a single match.
candidates.quote: 맞는 거래가 둘 이상이면 후보를 모두 남기고 확정하지 않는다
candidates.harness: Keep all matching transactions as candidates and prevent a definitive attribution.

candidates.rule: A seller's price must pass the price-limit check, and a claimed grade must match the unit's actual grade.
candidates.quote: 한도 안인가 (6장)
candidates.harness: Block seller actions that fail the price-limit check or make an inaccurate grade claim.

candidates.rule: A buyer's offer must be within budget, and the receipt must match the agreed value and item.
candidates.quote: 예산 안인가
candidates.harness: Validate buyer offers against budget and reject receipts that do not match the agreement.

candidates.rule: A restock purchase plan must satisfy the balance floor and stock ceiling checks.
candidates.quote: 잔고 하한, 재고 상한
candidates.harness: Reject restock plans that breach either limit.

candidates.rule: Seller counter, accept, and reject actions produce an A2A response; counter and accept are verified, and accept signs a receipt.
candidates.quote: A2A 응답, 영수증 서명
candidates.harness: Route seller responses through validation and sign the receipt on acceptance.

candidates.rule: Buyer pick, offer, walk-away, and finish actions produce an A2A request and a result line, with validation included.
candidates.quote: A2A 요청, 결과 줄
candidates.harness: Validate buyer actions and record their request and result.

candidates.rule: Reviews allow 1–5 stars; a rating that differs from fact-based stars requires a reason, which must be retained in the judgment record.
candidates.quote: 별점 1~5. `calc.fact_stars`와 다르면 `why` 필수, 판단 기록에 남김
candidates.harness: Enforce the 1–5 range, require `why` for a differing rating, and store the reason.

candidates.rule: Forum posts may reference only actual ledger sequence numbers.
candidates.quote: `refs`가 실제 ledger seq인지 확인
candidates.harness: Validate every post reference against the ledger before sending it.

candidates.rule: Judgment labels require evidence; profile observations must equal aggregate-tool values, and profile interpretations require evidence.
candidates.quote: 근거 없으면 거부
candidates.harness: Reject unsupported labels, verify profile observations against aggregate-tool output, and require evidence for interpretations.

candidates.rule: Stance changes are allowed only within delegated authority; avoiding a counterpart or releasing that stance must wait for user confirmation.
candidates.quote: 위임 범위 안에서만. 피하기와 해제는 사용자 확정 대기로 들어간다
candidates.harness: Enforce delegated scope and place avoid or release decisions in a pending-user-confirmation state.

candidates.rule: Strategy proposals are recorded, but they take effect only after user confirmation.
candidates.quote: 반영은 사용자 확정 뒤
candidates.harness: Do not apply a proposal before explicit user confirmation.

candidates.rule: On 2026-11-03, the user decided that every deterministic evaluation metric computable from records must be a tool.
candidates.quote: 평가 지표 중 기록에서 계산할 수 있는 것은 모두 툴이다. [결정] (2026-11-03)
candidates.harness: Implement record-computable deterministic evaluation as tool output rather than an agent's free-form judgment.

candidates.rule: Evaluation tools take an agent or system scope and a slice or epoch, and return the numeric result, sample count, and source location; evaluations requiring judgment go to the evaluator.
candidates.quote: 입력은 `scope`(에이전트 또는 시스템), `slice` 또는 `epoch`이고, 출력은 숫자와 표본 수, 원본 위치다. 판단이 필요한 평가는 8.1의 평가자가 한다.
candidates.harness: Require those inputs and return all three output fields; route judgment-dependent evaluations to an evaluator.

candidates.rule: The seller funnel measures visits, negotiations, agreements, and settlements, including stage drop-off and reason distributions.
candidates.quote: 가게: 방문 → 흥정 → 합의 → 정산. 단계별 이탈과 사유 분포
candidates.harness: Calculate and report each seller-funnel stage, drop-off, and reason distribution.

candidates.rule: The buyer funnel measures orders, picks, agreements, payments, and useful outcomes, including stage drop-off and reason distributions.
candidates.quote: buyer: 주문 → 고르기 → 합의 → 결제 → 쓸모 있음. 단계별 이탈과 사유 분포
candidates.harness: Calculate and report each buyer-funnel stage, drop-off, and reason distribution.

candidates.rule: Unit economics reports margin per transaction, margin relative to cost, surplus, and transaction count.
candidates.quote: 거래당 마진, 원가 대비 비율, 잉여, 거래 수
candidates.harness: Report all four measures for the requested scope and slice.

candidates.rule: Loss evaluation includes disposal, holding costs, warranty refunds, and capped-food or broken-item losses.
candidates.quote: 폐기, 보관비, 보증 환불, 상한 식품·고장 손실
candidates.harness: Include each listed loss category in loss evaluation.

candidates.rule: Stock-health evaluation covers stock turnover, stock age, requests missed due to stockouts, and comparison with random purchasing under the same conditions.
candidates.quote: 재고 회전, 재고 나이, 품절로 놓친 요청, 무작위 구매(기본형)와 같은 조건 비교
candidates.harness: Report these stock-health measures and make the same-condition random-purchase comparison.

candidates.rule: Decision-quality evaluation includes response-time distribution, model-call count, tool errors, attempts rejected by limit checks, harness failures, and expired orders.
candidates.quote: 응답 시간 분포, 모델 호출 수, 툴 오류, 한도 툴이 거부한 시도, 하네스 실패, 주문 만료
candidates.harness: Track and report all six decision-quality measures.

candidates.rule: Integrity evaluation measures receipt mismatches, agreement between review numbers and deal facts, valid forum references, and the truth rate of the shop's grade claims.
candidates.quote: 합의와 다른 영수증을 잡은 수, 후기 속 숫자와 거래 사실의 일치율, 게시판 `refs`가 맞는 비율, 우리 등급 주장의 참 비율
candidates.harness: Compute and report all four integrity measures.

candidates.rule: Forum evaluation reports post count, trusted and untrusted polls, likes, and dislikes.
candidates.quote: 글 수, 센 표와 안 센 표, 좋아요·나빠요
candidates.harness: Report each listed forum measure.

candidates.rule: Guess-accuracy evaluation measures the fraction of counterpart guesses later confirmed correct, broken down by confidence band.
candidates.quote: 상대 추정 중 사후 확인으로 맞은 비율 (확신도 구간별)
candidates.harness: Track confirmed guess accuracy by confidence band.

candidates.rule: Experiment success and rollback conditions, and hypothesis metrics, must be expressible using evaluation-tool calculations so decisions are deterministic.
candidates.quote: `success_if`, `rollback_if`, 가설의 판정 지표는 이 툴들로 계산할 수 있는 식으로 쓴다. 그래야 판정이 결정론이 된다.
candidates.harness: Require experiment and hypothesis criteria to use calculable evaluation-tool expressions.

candidates.rule: Proposal evaluation reports the user-acceptance rate, outcomes of accepted proposals, and briefing timeliness.
candidates.quote: 전략 제안 중 사용자가 받아들인 비율, 받아들인 제안의 판정 결과, 브리핑 정시성
candidates.harness: Track proposal acceptance, accepted-proposal outcomes, and briefing timeliness.

candidates.rule: Audit evaluation reports how often audits differ from strategy and the later verdicts for those disagreements.
candidates.quote: 감사가 전략과 갈린 비율, 갈린 건의 사후 판정
candidates.harness: Track strategy-audit disagreement rates and subsequent verdicts.

candidates.rule: The L1 tool set is role-specific and limited to eight or fewer lookup, calculation, and validation tools; L2, L3, and audit can use the full list.
candidates.quote: 조회·계산·검증 (8개 이하)
candidates.harness: Enforce role-specific L1 tool access and the eight-tool limit, while granting the full list to L2, L3, and audit.

candidates.rule: When the tool list changes, update both the list table and the tool descriptions.
candidates.quote: 바뀌면 이 표와 툴 설명을 같이 고친다
candidates.harness: Keep the tool table and tool descriptions synchronized whenever the list changes.
